evidence.claim: Big Spring Scenic Backway runs 68 miles between Cokeville and Kemmerer, following willow-lined river valleys into the Tunp Mountain Range.
evidence.quote: The Big Spring Scenic Backway is a 68-mile route from Kemmerer to Cokeville in Wyoming&rsquo;s southwestern Lincoln County. The Backway is crisscrossed by historic emigrant trails, parallels willowed river valleys, and plunges deep into the Tunp Mountain Range in the Bridger National Forest.

evidence.claim: This is an unimproved Forest Service road through remote country.
evidence.quote: The Backway is an unimproved Forest Service road where 4-wheel drive is highly recommended. Driving the Backway is very remote travel and requires excellent map navigation skills.
